configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.displayName: dev (macOS, native arch, optimised + symbols, ccache)
configurePresets.description: Edit-build-attach loop. RelWithDebInfo, NOT Debug: a Debug build is -O0 and makes every performance measurement meaningless. Native arch only, so ccache works.

configurePresets.name: dist
configurePresets.description: Shippable macOS build. ccache is deliberately absent: it cannot handle two -arch flags.

configurePresets.name: win-dev
configurePresets.description: Edit-build loop on Windows. Ninja, so run it from a 'x64 Native Tools' / Developer PowerShell prompt -- cl.exe must be on PATH. RelWithDebInfo for the same reason as dev. No ccache: not assumed present on a Windows box.

configurePresets.name: win-dist
configurePresets.description: Shippable Windows build. x86_64 only: Fusion ships win64, so an arm64 Windows host wants this same binary under emulation, not a native one Fusion cannot load.

configurePresets.name: win-vs
configurePresets.displayName: win-vs (Windows x64, Visual Studio 2022, for the debugger)
configurePresets.description: Fallback and IDE route. The VS generator finds its own toolchain, so it works from a plain shell with no vcvars -- use it when win-dev cannot find cl.exe, and when you want to attach VS to Fusion. Multi-config: pick the configuration at build time.
